rule: Contract only a current one-to-one edge when direct producer-consumer tensor bytes / 60 bytes per cycle plus expected avoided task wait exceeds min(endpoint compute cycles), and merged compute weight stays below total_work/(cores*blocks_per_core). Expected wait uses uniform same/cross-core placement probabilities from 100/1000 cycle waits.
holdout: none; development cases selected from static features before v005 performance runs
